exact_meaning: Set lambda=1: X_1(u,n)=-P_u+P_space, independent of n for fixed u.
For lambda not equal to 1, X_lambda generally depends on ruler direction n.
Pair and path labels are arguments of the relational family, not physical fields.
Screen SO(2) changes commute with scalar-screen X_lambda.
The stack can contain the pair-indexed readout layer without promoting it to physical configuration.
Founded phi does not itself assign depth to spacetime arrows.
Metric and scalar anchors alone have scalar Lorentz commutant and do not select the lift.
Layering supplies no response, action, or fixed-point feedback.
